written.headline: House Democrats open probe into Lutnick's ties to Nvidia
written.summary: House Judiciary and Foreign Affairs Committee Democrats are investigating whether Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick's decisions on AI chip export controls were influenced by his sons' firm Cantor Fitzgerald, which held an Nvidia stake reportedly valued around $1.2 billion. The probe follows Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang's ouster over his relationship with a suspected Chinese spy.

written.headline: Reson8 open-sources Rumble-2-Flash, a 0.5B speech model for 40+ languages
written.summary: Reson8 open-sourced Rumble-2-Flash, a 0.5B-parameter speech recognition model for 40+ languages, under the Apache 2.0 license. The company says it competes with models 3-60x its size and transcribes an hour of audio in about half a second.

written.headline: Microsoft and Intel expand partnership to boost Azure AI infrastructure
written.summary: Microsoft and Intel announced an expanded collaboration to enhance Azure infrastructure for cloud and AI workloads. The deal adds Intel Foundry’s EMIB packaging, next‑gen Xeon “Diamond Rapids” CPUs and CXL memory, promising up to 2.3× performance gains in M‑series v4 VMs and 2.5× faster SQL backups.
